questions.prompt: What is said about the open joints before the wind drops?

options.text: Every joint above the opening is running, which is exactly what those gaps are there for.
The brick is still soaking up the rain, so nothing has reached the tray yet.
Nothing comes out of them, which usually means the tray was laid without stop ends.
Whatever the tray has caught stays on it, because the wind presses in at those joints.
